organization.name: BIAI
organization.description: BIAI runs short, practical AI programs for individuals and companies in Bangladesh.

Bootcamp.summary: A short, hands-on AI bootcamp for people who want to build with AI tools.
Bootcamp.format: Live online classes with recordings available after each session.
Bootcamp.certificate: A BIAI certificate of completion is provided. Accreditation details are not published — staff must confirm.

Fellowship.summary: A longer guided program for people building a career in AI. Includes portfolio work and mentorship.
Fellowship.audience: People with some background, technical or non-technical, who want a structured path into AI work.
Fellowship.coding_required: Not required for every track. Staff must confirm for the applicant's chosen track.
Fellowship.certificate: A BIAI certificate of completion is provided. Accreditation details are not published — staff must confirm.

Corporate Training.summary: Custom AI training for teams and companies, delivered online or onsite.
Corporate Training.format: Online or onsite, scoped per company.
Corporate Training.next_step: A team member schedules a discovery call to scope headcount, goals and pricing.

payment.instalments: Instalment options may be available. Staff must confirm per program.
payment.confirmation: After payment, the team sends a confirmation by WhatsApp or email. If a customer paid and did not receive confirmation, ask them for the TrxID and the sender number.

policies.refunds: Refund eligibility depends on the program and timing. Staff must confirm before any refund is promised.
policies.discounts: Discounts may be available for students or groups. Staff must confirm before quoting.
policies.lifetime_access: Recordings for the program are shared with enrolled participants. Exact access terms must be confirmed by staff.
policies.add_ons: Add-ons are optional extras. Staff must confirm which add-ons are available for a specific cohort.

free_events.masterclass: BIAI occasionally runs free masterclasses. Eligibility (including for school students) must be confirmed by staff — do not promise a seat.

unknown_facts_policy: If a fact (price, start date, refund terms, certificate accreditation, instalment availability, discounts) is not in this knowledge base, the reply must ask a clarifying question or say a team member will confirm, and use a placeholder like [CONFIRM: price].
